text:
x2A | NYC, NY, USA | ONSITE | https://x2a.tech

We are actively looking for multiple software developers or software engineers to join our team (in the office, 5 days/week). These positions primarily focus on our 5off software product (puzzles/games).

There is zero expectation for you to be proficient in all aspects of the tech stack. We are looking for people who know some of these technologies and are excited to share their expertise while developing their skills and learning new things.

We welcome candidates at any experience level, with or without academic qualifications. For junior candidates, do not hesitate to share related personal projects.

Tech stack:

  - Languages: Python, Typescript, Swift, Rust, C++.
  - Backend: SQLAlchemy, PostgreSQL, Litestar.
  - Frontend: Svelte, Tailwind.
  - Mobile: Swift, SwiftUI.
  - Cloud: AWS, AWS CDK.
  - DevOps: Gitlab.
Compensation: 115k-170k based on experience and skills.

More https://x2a.tech/careers/openings/ for more details and how to apply.
